The same practical approach.

Start with what you need to get done. Each app has its own role, from working with your own spatial data to sharing a map with a crew or getting a daily report approved.

DrillOps

Daily reporting · Approval · Invoicing

Make daily activity reports easier for crews to complete, easier for clients to approve and easier for the office to reconcile against invoices.

Explore DrillOps ↗
02 /

FieldOps

Local GIS · Offline fieldwork

A powerful, offline-capable GIS toolkit for professionals and enthusiasts. Take spatial data with you, navigate, inspect terrain and capture useful field records.

Explore FieldOps ↗
03 /

FieldMaps

Coming soon · Web mapping · Team distribution

Prepare maps in the web portal, then publish them for workers and teams to open in the app. Make it clear where to go and which project information to use.

Explore FieldMaps ↗

Built around real tasks

What does your day need?

01 / REPORT THE SHIFT

Finish the DAR. Keep it moving.

A driller records the shift, the client reviews it, and the office has a clearer basis for checking charges. That is the job of DrillOps.

02 / WORK WITH YOUR MAPS

Take your GIS into the field.

Bring a drawing, terrain model or waypoint list. Work with it locally and capture what you find with FieldOps.

03 / DIRECT THE TEAM

Give everyone the right map.

Prepare the work locations in the FieldMaps web portal. Publish the map so assigned team members can open it in the app.
